nodes.text: You sew. I can see it in how you stand near the looms — respectfully. Very well: I have a commission I decline to describe and a shortage I do not. Eight lengths of gloomsilk thread. Four bolts of linen.
It means the crypts and the deep spiders, yes. Grave-spun, cold to the hand, drinks the light — and there is no substitute, which is why the commission pays. Beauty is labor. Some labor is dark.
The linen you may weave from honest scrap like anyone else. Bring me both, and the Row will owe you — and the Row pays its debts in cloth worth wearing.
Hm. The shortage remains, and shortages, unlike commissions, do not take refusals.
